final: WITH group_avgs AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_instownpct FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_instownpct) AS avg_of_group_avgs FROM group_avgs) SELECT AVG(g.avg_instownpct) AS mean_above_baseline, AVG(g.avg_instownpct - b.avg_of_group_avgs) AS mean_excess FROM group_avgs AS g CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE g.avg_instownpct > b.avg_of_group_avgs
